_comment: EFI Risk Engine — Weight Configuration v1.0.0
_disclaimer: These weights are configurable. Adjust to reflect domain expertise. Do not treat scores as legally authoritative.

change_magnitude.description: How large is the detected change (area, index delta)

temporal_persistence.description: Change confirmed across multiple observations (not a one-off)

model_confidence.description: Confidence of the detection model output

sar_corroboration.description: SAR data independently corroborates the optical change

environmental_proximity.description: Proximity to river, protected area, or ecologically sensitive zone

regulatory_context.description: Outside available mining lease boundary (when data is available)

notes: Risk score is NOT a legal determination.
Missing data reduces the applicable weight — it does not default to worst-case.
Regulatory data unavailability is explicitly surfaced in the UI.
